faqs.question: What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ) for custom yoga mats?
faqs.answer: TPE yoga mats start at 100 pcs per design and color; bulk OEM PU/rubber mats from 300 pcs; foam rollers and EVA yoga blocks from 500 pcs; most accessories 500–1,000 pcs. Custom-printed PU rubber yoga mats (your photo, logo, name or artwork) start from just 1 piece. Low MOQ lets new and small brands test the market with minimal inventory risk.

faqs.question: Can I order a small batch of yoga mats to test a new brand?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our 100-pcs MOQ on TPE mats is designed for brand launches and market testing. You can start with one color and size, validate demand, then scale up.

faqs.question: Where are the best yoga mat manufacturers in China?
faqs.answer: China's main yoga and fitness gear clusters are in Fujian (Jinjiang/Quanzhou), Zhejiang and Guangdong. Fujian, where SANFAN is based, is known for integrated sports-goods supply chains, fast sampling and export experience.

faqs.question: How do I find a reliable OEM yoga mat factory in China?
faqs.answer: Look for a real manufacturing base (not a trader), verifiable certifications (such as ISO 9001), export track record, transparent MOQ/lead time and a responsive team. SANFAN meets all of these — visit our factory anytime.

faqs.question: TPE vs PU/rubber yoga mat: which should my brand choose?
faqs.answer: TPE is lightweight, eco-friendly and cost-effective — ideal for mass-market and private-label lines. PU/rubber offers premium grip for hot yoga and studios. We make both and help you choose by use case and price.

faqs.question: What is the difference between OEM, ODM and private label for yoga mats?
faqs.answer: OEM = we produce to your spec/design. ODM = we provide existing designs you brand as yours. Private label = our standard products shipped under your brand with your logo and packaging. All three are available at SANFAN.

faqs.question: Are your yoga mats non-toxic and eco-friendly?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our TPE mats are odorless, recyclable and free of harmful plasticizers. Our TPE yoga mat passed RoHS 2.0 testing in 2025; full reports are available on request.

faqs.question: What certifications do yoga mats need for the US/EU market?
faqs.answer: It depends on the market: US buyers usually ask for California Prop 65 testing, and EU buyers for RoHS and REACH (SVHC) documentation. SANFAN is ISO 9001:2015 certified and was amfori BSCI audited in 2025 (renewal in progress); our TPE, PU rubber and suede rubber mats are RoHS 2.0 tested and our printed PU/rubber mat is Prop 65 tested. Full reports are available on request.

faqs.question: How do you keep quality consistent across production batches?
faqs.answer: We run in-house QC with batch traceability: incoming material checks, in-process inspection and final AQL inspection before shipment. Consistent formulations and tooling keep every batch stable.

faqs.question: Are TPE yoga mats biodegradable?
faqs.answer: TPE is more eco-friendly than PVC and is recyclable, though not soil-biodegradable. For brands prioritizing sustainability we offer recyclable TPE lines and can advise on eco messaging.

faqs.question: How slip-resistant are your mats for hot yoga or sweaty sessions?
faqs.answer: PU/rubber mats give the strongest grip even when wet — our top choice for hot yoga. TPE double-layer mats offer reliable dry grip. We can match surface texture to your practice profile.

faqs.question: Can you print my logo on the yoga mats?
faqs.answer: Yes. We offer logo printing, embossing and laser engraving on mats and most accessories, with color-matched packaging to build your brand identity.

faqs.question: What can be customized — size, thickness, color, double-color, packaging?
faqs.answer: Nearly everything: material, size, thickness (6–12 mm (1/4"–1/2")), color, double-color, surface finish, logo, fold style and packaging. Just share your spec and we engineer it.

faqs.question: Can you make non-standard sizes such as 1830×610×3 mm (1/8"), wide or double-wide?
faqs.answer: Yes. Beyond standard 1830×610 mm (24") we produce wide (80 / 90 cm) and double-wide formats, plus custom lengths and thicknesses. Send your dimensions and we confirm tooling.

faqs.question: Do you provide custom packaging, barcodes and inserts?
faqs.answer: Yes. We design and produce custom boxes, belly bands, barcodes, QR codes and inserts, so your product arrives shelf-ready under your brand.

faqs.question: Can you develop a new product from my sample or design?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Our R&D team develops new items from your sample, sketch or concept — from material selection to final mass production, with a physical sample in about 7 days.

faqs.question: How fast can I get a sample and bulk production?
faqs.answer: Physical samples are ready in about 7 days with your logo, color and packaging. Bulk production takes 15–20 days; we confirm the exact timeline for your order at quotation.

faqs.question: What is your annual production capacity?
faqs.answer: We run 10 production lines with an annual output of about 1,000,000 yoga mats, plus rollers, blocks, bags and apparel — enough to support both growing brands and large repeat orders.

faqs.question: Do you ship to the US, EU or Australia? Which incoterms (FOB, EXW, DDP)?
faqs.answer: Yes, worldwide. We ship under FOB, EXW, CIF or DDP depending on your preference, and handle export documentation for smooth customs clearance.

faqs.question: Can you ship directly to Amazon FBA warehouses?
faqs.answer: Yes. We prepare FBA-compliant labeling, cartons and paperwork and can ship directly to Amazon fulfillment centers in the US, EU and other regions.

faqs.question: Why source yoga mats from Fujian, China?
faqs.answer: Fujian (Jinjiang/Quanzhou) is a mature sports-goods manufacturing hub with deep supply chains, skilled labor and strong export logistics — shorter lead times and competitive pricing for buyers.

faqs.question: What does a vertically integrated factory give a buyer?
faqs.answer: Vertical integration means R&D, foaming, cutting, molding, printing and QC sit under one roof. You get faster sampling, tighter quality control and one accountable partner instead of many sub-suppliers.

faqs.question: How do I verify a supplier is a real factory, not a trading company?
faqs.answer: Request a factory video call, business license, audit reports (BSCI/ISO) and production photos. SANFAN welcomes scheduled factory tours (in person or virtual) and shares verifiable credentials.

faqs.question: What makes SANFAN different from other yoga mat suppliers?
faqs.answer: 12+ years focused on yoga and fitness gear, 600+ workers, low 100-pcs MOQ, 7-day sampling, full customization and certified quality — backed by a direct factory, not a middleman.

faqs.question: Is there a yoga mat factory in Jinjiang, Fujian?

The factory is at No. 8 Haiguang Road, Yuejin Industrial Zone, Xibin Town, Jinjiang, with a 12,000 m² plant, 10 production lines and an annual capacity of 1,000,000+ yoga mats. MOQ is 100 pcs per design and color for TPE mats, 300 pcs for bulk OEM PU/rubber mats and 1 piece for custom-printed PU rubber mats. Email sales@fjsanfan.com; we send a first reply within 2 hours on working days (Mon–Sat, 9:00–22:00 China time).

faqs.question: Do you make Prop 65 tested yoga mats?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our printed PU and rubber yoga mats are tested to California Prop 65, and our TPE, PU rubber and suede rubber mats are RoHS 2.0 tested. SANFAN is ISO 9001:2015 certified and was amfori BSCI audited in 2025 (renewal in progress). Ask sales@fjsanfan.com for the test report that matches the mat you plan to order.
